rendered:
According to the document, the PVDF binder was not dissolved in ethylene glycol during delamination. This is supported by the FTIR and EDX spectra, which show that the characteristic peaks of pristine PVDF were still present in the delaminated electrode material. 

The Hansen solubility parameters were also calculated, and it was found that ethylene glycol (EG) has a high Ra value of 16.9 (MPa)^1/2, indicating that it has a low ability to dissolve PVDF. This is consistent with the experimental results, which showed that the PVDF binder was not dissolved in EG during delamination.
